description: EasiCoin is a leading crypto exchange, backed by strong financial support, top reputation, and regulatory compliance. Your gateway to the future of finance.
faq-ans-a: New users who sign up and activate a futures account can unlock a generous new user gift package and participate in exclusive new user activities to earn additional rewards.
faq-ans-b-1: One-time tasks: Can only be claimed once; rewards are given upon completion.
faq-ans-b-2: Tiered tasks: Completed in stages with cumulative rewards.
faq-ans-b-3: Advanced tasks: Only the final reward can be claimed once.
faq-ans-c: All tasks have a validity period. Once expired, they cannot be claimed or completed. Some beginner tasks must be completed within 7 days of registration.
faq-ans-d: Trading progress is not synced in real time and usually takes more than 1 hour to update. Please wait patiently for the system to process, then refresh the page and check again.
faq-ans-e: Only the actual trading volume (excluding fees) is counted. For example, if you trade 100 USDT, your task progress increases by 100 USDT.
faq-ans-f: After completing the corresponding operations, the task will be automatically marked as completed. Once the conditions are met, you can claim the reward on this page. After claiming successfully, please go to the Voucher Center to activate and use the corresponding voucher.
faq-ans-g-0: If you have not received the reward, possible reasons are as follows:
faq-ans-g-1: ·Your account does not qualify as a new user account. New user tasks are only available to newly registered users.
faq-ans-g-2: ·The task requirements have not been met;
faq-ans-g-3: ·The reward has not yet synced to the Voucher Center. Please refresh the page and check again later.
faq-ans-g-4: If you are still unable to claim your reward, please contact our customer support for assistance.
faq-ans-h-1: After completing the required tasks, your eligibility will be reviewed automatically by the system. Once approved, you can claim your rewards from the Rewards Hub page. After claiming them, your rewards will be credited to the Voucher Center:
faq-ans-h-2: 1. After completing the required tasks, go to the Rewards Hub page and click "Claim Rewards".
faq-ans-h-3: 2. Go to the Voucher Center, find the reward voucher, then activate and use it.
faq-ans-h-6: If your reward does not appear immediately after completing the task, we recommend refreshing the page or checking again later.
faq-ans-h-7: For voucher usage rules, validity periods, and other details, please refer to the Voucher Center for details.
faq-ans-i: To ensure the fairness and impartiality of the campaign, EasiCoin strictly prohibits any form of cheating, including but not limited to malicious volume farming, wash trading, bulk account registration and other irregular operations.If any user is found to have engaged in activities that disrupt the normal operation of the campaign, the platform reserves the right to revoke their eligibility for the campaign and reclaim any related rewards.All campaign data and results are subject to the records in the EasiCoin platform system.
faq-ans-j: EasiCoin reserves the right to adjust the event rules and rewards based on market conditions. Such changes may be made without prior notice. EasiCoin reserves the right to the final interpretation of Rewards Hub events. For inquiries, please contact our support team at: support@easicoin.io

trial-cash-info-1: Futures Bonus can be used for margin, trading fees, closing losses, and funding fees related to contract trading.
trial-cash-info-2: When trading futures with a Trial Bonus, losses will first be deducted from your own assets before being deducted from the Trial Bonus.
trial-cash-info-3: When your account has both a Fee Voucher and a Trial Bonus, trading fees will be deducted from the Fee Voucher first.
trial-cash-info-4: The system will automatically clear upon expiration; if you hold positions using futures bonus  at that time, the trial portion will be deducted automatically, which may trigger liquidation. Please pay attention to the expiration time in advance.
trial-cash-info-5: When transferring funds from the contract account to other accounts, futures bonus  will be immediately reclaimed.
trial-cash-info-6: Only for contract trading use; cannot be withdrawn, transferred, or sent to another account.
